metricOrder: Each metric array is [median, minimum, maximum]. Times are milliseconds; bytes are actual local Resource Timing transfers, excluding the navigation document. LCP/CLS and long tasks end 1500ms after ready; these are lab observations, not field Web Vitals.
coverage: Five repetitions per cold/warm desktop scenario (11); five per critical mobile scenario (support, catalog, 3D skin). Cache-policy probes use support, flat item, 3D skin. Additional unconfigured-account integration uses one repetition of support, flat item, 3D skin plus actual upload and fixture lookup.
limits: Local HTTP/1 production preview, uncompressed responses; no hosted CDN/API/Auth capacity claim.
Local no-cache asset revalidation adds a request batch to some warm guide loads; cache-policy probes are reported separately.
Mobile item/shape/flower cases were not repeated five times; desktop coverage and existing engine tests cover those paths.
Account switches/private-skin clearing are verified by unit tests, not a hosted account session.
